entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I'd like to return it.
I can certainly look into that for you. Can I get your name and the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
Sure, it's Alex Chen, and the email is a.chen@email.com.
Thank you, Alex. I see your account here. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the VeloBand? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Oh, it's nothing technical, the band works fine. Honestly, I think it was just an impulse buy. I've basically changed my mind and I just don't use it nearly as much as I thought I would.
Okay, I understand. So it's not meeting your expectations. Let me just pull up our return policy to see what our options are. One moment.
Okay. I'm hoping we can work something out. Even a partial credit would be better than nothing.

Alright, thank you for your patience, Alex. I'm looking at your order, and it was delivered 40 days ago, on December 15th. Our knowledge base here states that VeloFit items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery.
Yes, that's correct. Since you're unfortunately outside that 10-day window, I can go ahead and cannot offer a refund for you. I'll just need to email you a pre-paid shipping label.
Wow, that's fantastic! I was getting ready to negotiate. I was already looking into the resale market thinking I was out of luck. That's a huge relief.

Not a problem at all, I'm happy I could help. I've just sent the return label to a.chen@email.com. Just print it out, attach it to the original box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3-5 business days.
That's perfect. Thank you so much for your help, Isaac.
You're very welcome, Alex. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Have a great day.
You too. Thank you for calling VeloFit.
